messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

So by the time I had finished filing out the new one my arms were aching and did I mention that my arms were aching not only because I had to fill them out but also because I had to do it three times?

output.fear: So by the time I had managed to finish filing out the new one, my arms were aching, and I feared I might never be able to lift them again after doing it three times.
output.anger: By the time I had finished filling out the new one, my arms were aching, and it infuriates me that I had to do it three times!

output.disgust: By the time I had forced myself to finish filling out the new one, my arms were aching, and I can't believe I had to go through that process three times—it’s just so frustrating.
